title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: As Shruthi is missing, Thangaraj requests the groom's family to postpone the bride-viewing ceremony. Malar and Revathi head out to bring her back, with Thangaraj quietly following.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan intervenes when Meena and Raji admire Thangamayil's baby bump. Meanwhile, Raji grows suspicious after noticing Kathir, Senthil and Saravanan talking secretly.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha insists on dining out with Cheran despite Nila's meal at home. Their evening takes a turn when Cheran urges her to hurry so they can return home early, upsetting her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Nachiyar forces Vijaya to cook alone while Meena secretly assists. Muthu is troubled after Sathya ignores him, prompting Annamalai to advise patience and plan a trip.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam praises Sethupathi and Dr. Nesan for organising a free eye care camp for his ward. Meanwhile, Eshwari joins forces with Abinav to sabotage the camp.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik covers for Kasthuri at college. Meanwhile, Aadhavan meets Vyshali at a cafe and, under Pooja's watchful eye, refuses to marry her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: With help from Indhira's tech-savvy friend, the QR scammer's location is traced. After a frantic search, Murugan and his brothers track him down with his gang.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 25: Grand Opening, Grand Problem
description: BB Hotel opens with outrage as food delays anger guests. Manager Lakshmi Priya confronts Dhanya and Javeed over kitchen blunders, leaving Dhanya in tears.
